macros.name: gabcsnippet
macros.doc: Converts the gabc notation specified in #1 to GregorioTEX and includes it directly in the document.

macros.name: greafterheaders
macros.doc: Specifies TeX code processed after the processing of the headers of a score.

macros.name: greannotation
macros.doc: Macro to add annotations (the text which appears above the initial) to a score.

macros.name: grebarbracewidth
macros.doc: Returns the em-relative width of a bar brace when braces are rendered by METAPOST (as opposed to fonts).

macros.name: grebeforeheaders
macros.doc: Specifies TeX code processed before the processing of the headers of a score.

macros.name: grebolshiftcleftype
macros.doc: Macro to determine how notes should be left aligned in the case where clefs of different widths appear in the same score.

macros.name: grechangecount
macros.doc: Macro to change one of GregorioTEX’s counts or penalities (numeric values).

macros.name: grechangedim
macros.doc: Macro to change one of GregorioTEX’s distances.

macros.name: grechangeglyph
macros.doc: Substitutes the given GregorioTEX score glyph with the specified glyph from the specified font.

macros.name: grechangestaffsize
macros.doc: Macro to adjust the size of the staff.

macros.name: grechangestyle
macros.doc: Command to change styling of a score element.

macros.name: grecommentary
macros.doc: Macro to add commentary (the text flush right at the top, usually a scripture reference) to a score.

macros.name: greconffactor
macros.doc: A count which indicates the staff size that a space configuration file is designed for.

macros.name: gredefsizedsymbol
macros.doc: Defines (or redefines) a TeX control sequence to be a non-score symbol which requires a single numeric argument (in points) to which the symbol will be scaled.

macros.name: gredefsymbol
macros.doc: Defines (or redefines) a TeX control sequence to be a non-score symbol.

macros.name: gregorioscore
macros.doc: Macro for including scores.

macros.name: greillumination
macros.doc: Macro to add an illuminated initial.

macros.name: greloadholehollowfonts
macros.doc: If set to false, will not load the hollow and hole variants of the next font to load.

macros.name: greloadspaceconf
macros.doc: Macro to load a space configuration file.

macros.name: grelocalbolshiftcleftype
macros.doc: Equivalent of \grebolshiftcleftype but valid only until the next end of a score, and with more options.

macros.name: greornamentation
macros.doc: A macro for invoking one of the ornamentation elements which are contained in the greextra font.

macros.name: greresetcavumglyph
macros.doc: Removes a pair of GregorioTEX score cavum glyph substitution, restoring them back to their original form.

macros.name: greresetglyph
macros.doc: Removes a GregorioTEX score glyph substitution, restoring it back to its original form.

macros.name: grescaledim
macros.doc: Macro to turn on or off scaling with the staff size for a particular distance.

macros.name: greseparator
macros.doc: A macro for invoking one of the five separators (fancy lines) which are contained in the greextra font.

macros.name: gresetabovelinestext
macros.doc: Sets the visibility of the above lines text.

macros.name: gresetalterationeffect
macros.doc: Macro to set the effect of alterations (flats and sharps), for the purpose of deciding whether to print soft alterations (see §6.4.3).

macros.name: gresetannotationby
macros.doc: Macro to specify which line of the annotation should be used to determine its starting placement (i.e. before annotationraise is applied).

macros.name: gresetannotationvalign
macros.doc: Macro to specify which part of the control line in the annotation should be aligned with the top line of the staff before annotationraise is applied.

macros.name: gresetbarspacing
macros.doc: Macro to activate the new bar spacing algorithm.

macros.name: gresetbolshifts
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether GregorioTEX should apply a small shift at the beginning of each line so that lines are aligned on the notes rather than the syllable text.

macros.name: gresetbracerendering
macros.doc: Macro to tell GregorioTEX whether to use METAPOST or fonts to render braces.

macros.name: gresetbreakbeforeeuouae
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether an automatic linebreak before a EUOUAE area is justified or not.

macros.name: gresetbreakineuouae
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether line breaks are allowed inside a EUOUAE area (delimited by <eu></eu> tags in gabc).

macros.name: gresetbreakintranslation
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether line breaks are allowed inside a translation.

macros.name: gresetclef
macros.doc: Macro to tell GregorioTEX whether the clefs should be printed or not.

macros.name: gresetclivisalignment
macros.doc: Macro to determine the method used for aligning the clivis with its lyrics.

macros.name: gresetcompilegabc
macros.doc: A macro to change the behavior of the way GregorioTEX includes scores.

macros.name: gresetcustosalteration
macros.doc: Macro for setting whether an alteration (flat, sharp, or natural) should be rendered before a custos or not.

macros.name: greseteolcustos
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether GregorioTEX should automatically place the custos at a line break.

macros.name: greseteolhyphen
macros.doc: Marco to determine how much space the hyphen at the end of a line occupies for the purposes of spacing calculations (the visible appearance of the hyphen is unchanged).

macros.name: greseteolshifts
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether GregorioTEX should apply a small shift at the end of each line which allows lyrics to stretch under the final custos.

macros.name: gresetgabcforcecenters
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether a forced center (i.e., one specified by curly braces (“{” and “}”) in your gabc file) should influence the alignment of that syllable when syllable and firstletter alignments are in effect.

macros.name: gresetglyphstyle
macros.doc: GregorioTEX supports several glyph styles which can be changed with this macro.

macros.name: gresetgregoriofont
macros.doc: Set the font used for the neumes.

macros.name: gresetgregpath
macros.doc: Set a list of additional directories which should be searched for scores.

macros.name: gresethepisema
macros.doc: Determines whether GregorioTEX should join (bridge) horizontal episemata on adjacent notes.

macros.name: gresethyphen
macros.doc: Tells GregorioTEX how to place a hyphen between syllables in polysyllabic words in a score.

macros.name: gresetinitiallines
macros.doc: Sets the number of lines the score initial requires (any non-negative integer).

macros.name: gresetlastline
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether the last line of the score should be justified or not.

macros.name: gresetledgerlineheuristic
macros.doc: Macro which enables or disables ledger line heuristics.

macros.name: gresetlinecolor
macros.doc: Macro for changing the color of the staff lines.

macros.name: gresetlineheightexpansion
macros.doc: Macro to configure line height expansion behavior when notes appear above or below the staff lines.

macros.name: gresetlines
macros.doc: Macro for setting whether the staff lines should be rendered or not.

macros.name: gresetlinesbehinddottedbar
macros.doc: Macro for setting whether the staff lines behind a dotted bar should be shown or not.

macros.name: gresetlyriccentering
macros.doc: Macro to set how the text of the lyrics aligns with the alignment point of its respective neumes.

macros.name: gresetlyrics
macros.doc: Sets the visibility of the lyrics.

macros.name: gresetmodenumbersystem
macros.doc: Sets the number system used for the mode number.

macros.name: gresetnabc
macros.doc: Sets the visibility of a nabc voice.

macros.name: gresetnabcfont
macros.doc: Macro to set the font to be used for the ancient notation.

macros.name: gresetnotes
macros.doc: Sets the visibility of the notes.

macros.name: gresetoutputdir
macros.doc: Sets the name of the output directory where gtex and glog files will be written.

macros.name: gresetpointandclick
macros.doc: Macro to enable or disable the point-and-click feature.

macros.name: gresetprotrusionfactor
macros.doc: Sets a global protrusion factor.

macros.name: gresetpunctumcavum
macros.doc: A shortcut for switching to the alternative punctum cavum and back.

macros.name: gresetshiftaftermora
macros.doc: Macro to change the behaviour for separation between notes of two syllables when the first ends with a punctum mora.

macros.name: gresetspecial
macros.doc: Sets a special character.

macros.name: gresetsyllablerewriting
macros.doc: Sets whether the last part of a non-final syllable of a word is moved to the next syllable when there is no hyphen.

macros.name: gresettranslation
macros.doc: Sets the visibility of the translations.

macros.name: gresettranslationcentering
macros.doc: Macro to specify how the translation text should be aligned with it respective syllable text.

macros.name: gresetunisonbreakbehavior
macros.doc: Macro to determine whether an automatic linebreak may occur between unison notes over a syllable.

macros.name: gretilde
macros.doc: Macro to print ∼.

macros.name: greunsetspecial
macros.doc: Un-sets a special character.
